808	RETURNS TRIGGER

813	  IF OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
814	    NEW.status_history = COALESCE(OLD.status_history, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
815	      'from', OLD.status,
816	      'to',   NEW.status,
817	      'at',   NOW(),
818	      'by',   COALESCE(auth.uid()::text, 'system')
819	    );
820	  END IF;
821	  RETURN NEW;
822	END;
823	$$;

828	  FOR EACH ROW
829	  EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_bookings_append_status_history();

21	  actor_id TEXT;
